[1/3] Scientifically accurate planetary physics (gravity, atmosphere, temperature, habitability), 2D Euclidean sublight transit distance/ticks, and persistent tick-synced radar transit animation

impact_assessment.why: User requested that clicking transit does not end the animation early, sublight transit calculates true orbital distance and advances appropriate ticks, and planetary atmosphere, gravity, temperature, and habitability are scientifically accurate.
impact_assessment.benefits: Continuous tick-synchronized radar transit trajectory until arrival, accurate 2D polar-to-Cartesian Euclidean orbital distance and sublight tick scaling, and astrophysically grounded planetary radius, density, surface gravity, stellar-flux equilibrium temperature, atmospheric composition/pressure, and Earth Similarity habitability index.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CelestialBody gains habitability field and updated atmosphere/gravity/temperature values; dependency: none (stdlib math only); concurrency: thread-safe SimulationEngine lock preserved; state: legacy saves need deterministic physics and habitability backfill without altering RNG seed streams.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve exact RNG call counts in GalaxyGenerator._generate_bodies, backfill legacy saves in SimulationEngine._bootstrap_frontier, and verify with failing-first unit and cockpit tests.
